data.name: Kamillah
data.gender_notes: Kamillah is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Kamillah is derived from the Arabic word ‘kamillah’ which means 'perfect, pure, and well-formed'. In Christian tradition, it is believed that this name signifies a delicate and beautiful soul who embodies the essence of purity and grace. The name Kamillah carries the meaning “Pure and Perfumed Flower” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Kamillah usually hope their child will grow to embody pure and perfumed flower and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Represents the blossoming of the soul, symbolizing inner beauty, and the purity of heart and spirit.
data.etymology: Kamillah belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Pure and Perfumed Flower.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Kamillah total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

It is a striking and powerful name, tantalizing the ears with its musicality and allure. In different cultures and communities, the name is often associated with beauty, perfection, and dignity. Its use among Christians adds an additional layer of meaning, connecting it to the divine and offering a reminder of spiritual ideals.
data.spiritual_significance: For Christians, the name Kamillah holds deep spiritual significance. The perfect and pure essence of the name reflects the profound ideals of Christianity, highlighting the importance of living a virtuous and holy life. In the biblical sense, Christians strive to be like God, and the name Kamillah can serve as a constant reminder of this divine calling. It also emphasizes the importance of inner beauty and purity as essential components of a true Christian's character. By choosing this name, Christians can be encouraged and inspired to uphold the highest spiritual ideals and lead lives that truly reflect the love and grace of God.
